text:
Harbor desk copy from Kralendijk. Rafael Martis took the noon boat stamp and filed the page while it was still damp. The masthead sender is Anchorline Chandlery on slip KC-7721. The printed charge is USD 1,486.75 for chain, two fenders, and a short splice. The stamp date reads 17 March 2026. A pencilled "masha danki" sits under the box, and the scan broke chan-
dlery across the crease. Older slip KC-7714 quoting 890.00 is in the same folder and is the wrong sheet. No insurer block was filled. A coffee ring hides the phone line, the stamp says PART PAID, and the clerk initialled RM.

Shop copy kept in Willemstad. Liselotte Wijngaarde slid it over the counter with a thumb smudge on the corner. Folio Press bill WM-3088 lists harbour chart folio, pilot lamp set, and waxed envelope pack. Printed job charge 638.40. Issued 4 June 2026, credit line 21 days. Under the stamp she wrote "paga den tempu". Quote WM-3081 for 512.00 was crossed out and is not this sheet. The margin OCR split fol-
io on the carbon. A red PAID stamp overlaps the till line, and the clerk dotted the corner twice.

lines.instruction: Each supply line printed on the bill

settle_by.instruction: Issue date plus the stated credit days

text:
Provision slip written at The Bottom, on Saba. Elsje Hassell filled it while the generator coughed through the morning landing. Stone Steps Provisions bill SB-1146 shows printed charge USD 2,075.40 for rice, lamp oil, and nails. Heading date 9 February 2027, credit strip 18 days. She added "betaald half" in the margin, and the scanner split provi-
sions on a crease. Prior note SB-1102 quoting 1,990.00 is clipped behind this page and is the wrong total. No policy code was typed on the form. The RECEIVED stamp is blurred and the pencil note trails off.

due.instruction: Start date plus the credit days

policy.instruction: Policy code typed on the form

text:
Workshop ticket left in Cockburn Town. Idris Forbes set it on the bench after the rain squall. Osprey Forge bill CT-5519 covers hinge pin replacement, deck cleat weld, and locker latch reset. Labour is 6 hours at 87.25 per hour. Clock-out reads 3:40 pm. Ticket date 11/08/2026. He scrawled "work dun" below the lines, and a grease thumb split cle-
at on the carbon. Old guess 480.00 on CT-5488 is pencilled at the top and is not the labour figure. Stamp says BENCH COPY.

jobs.instruction: Each job line on the ticket

text:
Canvas loft note from West Bay. Nadine Ebanks pinned it above the cutting table before lunch. Mangrove Canvas Works bill WB-2294 logs the job at 22 April 2027 9:15 am. Face gross is 3,240.80 and the credit note is 415.30. A separate promise date is 03/02/2027. She wrote "see you soon" along the hem, and the scan broke can-
vas through the logo. A crossed-out guess of 2,900.00 sits in the corner and is not the balance. Stamp says LOFT COPY, initials NE, with a smear of chalk on the total box.

promised.instruction: The other date written on the sheet

text:
Yard docket copied in Plymouth, Montserrat. Cedric Buffonge wrote it after the afternoon shower, the sheet still cockled. Gage Timber Yard bill MS-8840 names cedar sill board, galvanised hinge pair, and roofing felt roll. The three charges read 128.40, 76.15, and 349.20. Docket date 28/11/2026. He put "tek care" in the corner, and the copier split galva-
nised on the fold. Last year tally 610.40 on MS-8702 is stapled behind this and is a different bill. A blurred PAID stamp covers the telephone line.

items.instruction: Each material line on the docket

text:
Slip shed docket, stamped by Keisha Liburd in Charlestown, Nevis after the night weld cooled and the ferry rail would lift cleanly. Hours on the card are 7.25 at EC$38.40. The old chalkboard quote of 241.75 is stale and must not be copied onto the fair sheet. The rail went out on 14/03/2026. Code NVS-4418 sits in the margin under a salt smear. There is still no insurer reference beside the signature. The carbon split wel
der on the crease, and the mate's 'tout fini' stays because nobody would rub it out. The foreman wants the fair copy before the Tuesday boat.

labour.instruction: Hours times the rate on the slip docket

issued.instruction: Date the ferry rail went out

text: Pencil card from the Codrington lagoon workshop. Patrice Beazer is writing because the pad is still damp. He fitted a lagoon pump seal, then a brass cotter pin, then a split hose clamp, and only then would the skiff leave the jetty. The card shows 5.75 hours at XCD 29.60, dated 21/05/2026. He crossed out last April's wrong quote of 151.25. Live docket BDA-7731 carries his initials. Faded BDA-7702 is the old carbon, not this job. The typed line reads fin ished, an OCR gap left under the workshop stamp. A visiting hand had scrawled 'ya listo' along the edge. The owner collects at dusk if the seal holds.

parts.instruction: Each fitting placed before the skiff left

labour.instruction: Hours times the rate on the pencil card

issued.instruction: Date written on the pencil card

text:
Before lunch at the Fort-de-France dry dock, Camille Dormoy pinned three notes to the gross sheet: keel zinc swap, packing gland reset, and anode bond wire. Gross is 864.55 and the yard credit is 147.80. An older scribbled balance of 690.25 sits in the corner and she will not reuse it. Opened 16/05/2026, gate closed 28/05/2026. Stamp says vu. Live file FDF-8820. The spoiled twin FDF-8811 stays unmarked. She had written 'bon pour' when a crease cut the next syl
lable, so the carbon now reads as two lines. The yard master wants this sheet before the whistle.

notes.instruction: Each note pinned to the gross sheet

docked.instruction: Days from the open date to the close date

text:
After the storm drill, Solange Niborel locked the Basse-Terre archives cage and wrote what she had actually moved: a tide gauge roll, a spare fuse card, a salt-stained logbook, and a copper earth strap. The cage card is dated 18/09/2027. The permit line is blank on purpose. Live code BT-6642 is under the stamp. Lookalike BT-6640 belongs to a drawer she did not open. A damp thumb broke ar
chives on the duplicate. The night shift gets the Creole note 'sé bon' and nothing further. The drill log itself stays in the cage; only the four packets named here were shifted.

permit.instruction: Permit reference for the cage move

text:
The Pointe-a-Pitre signal loft log is one ruled card. Nadia Clovis will not let the day clerk rewrite it. The watch opened 14/06/2026 and closed 29/06/2026 once the lamp test held through the haze. Live ticket PAP-6407. A spoiled twin, PAP-6401, sits unmarked in the margin so the wrong slip cannot be filed under the loft stamp. Punch holes split sig
nal. Under that she wrote 'vu et clos'. No interval count is on this card, not in digits and not in words. Haze sat on the light the whole watch, and the lamp still held.

waited.instruction: Days from the open date to the close date

text:
Night slate at the Schoelcher cold store. Mireille Lurel priced three small jobs and refused to draw a total under them. A crate wash at 14.65, an ice top-up at 26.80, and a night latch check at 7.35. The slate is dated 30/10/2026. Last month's wrong total of 39.15 is still chalked in the corner; do not copy it onto the fair line. She signed SCH-3307. SCH-3302 is void. The crack split sto
re on the painted sign. The morning clerk gets 'à part' so the three lines stay apart. The compressor knocked twice, and she left that noise out of the figures.

jobs.instruction: Each small job priced on the slate

text:
Amina Soler from the chandlery desk, writing while the pad window is still open. The workboat wants one berth figure for the week she lies off Kourou, and the mate will not accept the printed card. I walked the eight slips we still trust, paint order, no sorting: 30, 50, 80, 120, 160, 210, 260, 320. The coffee-ring card in the drawer says 190 and it is not this week. STAMP: RECU. tant pis, the carbon tore and chandl
ery split across the line. The mate is waiting on the radio and the hold is still empty. Sit between the two central slips and leave that old card in the drawer.

estimate.instruction: Berth figure between the two central slips

text:
Joseph Ade, fuel coop, the morning book still damp from the river air. Barges loading rice want a single drum price at Sinnamary, taken from the four lots on the board and from nothing else. Left to right, as posted: 640, 780, 920, 1100. Faded chalk under the lots still reads 990, a dry-month wish, and I will not sell that. c'est noté au crayon. The page tore, so bar
ge sits on two lines. He wants the figure before the barges cast off. Use only the two middle lots, before the tide turns and the weeping pump seal stains the book.

estimate.instruction: Drum price between the two central lots

text:
Rosa Ipek, stores cupboard, closing the evening round with the lamp already hot. Sealed gauze tins still on the shelf at Saint-Laurent-du-Maroni were counted on 4 March 2026, and I kept the six readable tins in the order I lifted them: 6, 9, 14, 18, 25, 33. Tag SLM-22 is tied to the rejected lid and does not belong in this count. vu et transmis. The stamp smeared, so gau
ze broke over the line. The cupboard smells of iodine and the lamp ticks. For the night book I need the quiet figure between the two central tins, not the tag on the lid.

estimate.instruction: Tin count between the two central readings

counted_on.instruction: Day the gauze tins were counted

text:
Paulo Neri, stick gauge, east bank, before the rain reaches the step. Boats that crossed at Oiapoque are one morning to a line, and no other words share that line. Sheet OIA-57 is a stained week from earlier and stays out of this run. água baixou, then the stick argued, so the pencil counts are the only ones I trust. The carbon slipped and cros
sing broke in half. The dog slept on the step and I stepped over him. Read the next three mornings from the lines below and do not borrow a figure from the stained sheet.
2026-09-01|88
2026-09-02|95
2026-09-03|101

Camila Ortiz, night counter, shutter half down and the fan ticking against the frame. People who asked for the green syrup at Leticia are written one closing to a line. The Tuesday scrap said 18 and it belongs to another bottle, so it stays off this strip. todavía no cierra, and the clerk who left the book had already gone to eat rice. The carbon slipped, so syr
up sits on two lines. The shutter sticks, so I left it where it was. I need the next two closings from this run only.
2026-10-01|20
2026-10-02|24
2026-10-03|29

Yves Monfils, ferry desk, lamp smoking, book warped from the damp. Foot passengers who paid the dawn crossing at Saint-Georges are one morning to a line, with no names beside the count. Card SG-41 is a market day that got wet and is not this week. à vérifier before anybody adds a column in the margin. The ribbon jammed and pass
engers broke across two lines. Mosquitoes found the lamp and I kept the book open. Take the next three mornings off this strip and leave the market card in the tin.
2026-11-01|11
2026-11-02|14
2026-11-03|16
2026-11-04|19

Night sheet from the shed. Sione Tereva, night radio keeper, got the lamp going again over the Avarua quay and wrote while the set hissed. Live slip AV-WX-8841 is the one to file. Drawer copy AV-WX-7720 is last week's sheet and is not this watch. Watch phrases, in the order he heard them: reef spray, gust front, low cloud. Stamp date on the foot is 7 March 2026. Salt cracked the word wat
ch on the carbon. Margin note says kia orana. The quay was loud with winches, and he kept the volume down so the phrases stayed readable. Insurer line was never filled. Initials ST.

watch_phrases.instruction: Each watch phrase in the order written

text: Talia Hepeti binds the afternoon post at Alofi and this docket came up damp. Binder code on the live card: AL-BIN-3096. She had already crossed the twin AL-BIN-1184, a morning card that does not belong to this bundle. The phrases on the flap are torn wrapper, wax seal, and blue twine. Docket date copied through as 2026/11/19. The typewriter left bun dle split, so she rewrote it. Under the stamp she put fakaalofa lahi atu. The bundle smelled of wet paper, and the twine dye came off on her thumb. No carrier reference was on the string.

flap_phrases.instruction: Each phrase written on the flap

text:
Elspeth Quinn, seed-store clerk, pinned this to the bench at Burnt Pine once the mist lifted off the glass. Live bench tag BP-NSY-6084. The old tag BP-NSY-4418 is still stuck to the shelf and is not the live one. Cover date, copied by hand: 14/01/2027. The tray was opened 9 August 2026 and closed 2026-09-03. A blot cut ger
mination in half on the carbon. She left the tray on the upper shelf so the next clerk would see the tag first, then signed EQ. Buyer reference was never entered. STAMP: filed.

tray_span.instruction: Days from the open date to the close date

text:
From the dues shed in The Valley, in Anguilla. Imani Gumbs, wharf dues clerk, filled the chit while the ferry horn went. Live code TV-DUE-7734. Last season sits on TV-DUE-2208 with an old total of 61.20, and that figure is not this page. Lines on the chit: mooring rope at 18.40, lamp oil at 27.15, and wharf chalk at 9.60. Issue date April 2, 2026. The horn drowned the first line, so she rewrote the rope entry more darkly. The stamp smeared rec
eived. Rope was salt-stiff. Signed IG.

store_lines.instruction: Each stores phrase on the chit

text:
Nadine Querrard runs the reading room in Gustavia and left the roster under the lamp after the shutters stuck. Live roll GS-ROL-2468. Someone had quoted GS-ROL-1357 from the drawer; that roll is not the one on this desk. Tasks in the order she entered them: linen count, candle stubs, and guest cards. It opened 16 October 2026 and closed 06/11/2026. Cover date copied as 2027-02-08. The aisle lamp buzzed the whole time, and she kept the cards in a single stack. A crease split ros
ter. She wrote bon courage in the margin and signed NQ. Visitor pass line is empty.

roster_span.instruction: Days from the open date to the close date

text:
Solene Brin, stall fitter, wrote this under the Marigot awning as the rain started on the crates. Job code MG-FIT-5193 is live. Superseded slip MG-FIT-2208 still shows 74.10 and is the old figure, not this job. Fitted, in order: cable ties, fuse caps, and bracket screws. Hours were 5 at a rate of 18.33. Issue date 27/08/2026. She wiped the slip, but ink still broke bra
cket on the carbon. She added merci, signed SB, and left the footing blank.
